name: set_timer
description: Start a countdown timer for a given number of minutes.

duration_minutes.description: How long the timer runs, in minutes.

name: send_message
description: Send a short text message to one of the user's contacts.

recipient.description: Name of the contact to write to.

name: control_lights
description: Turn the lights of a room on or off.

name: calendar_lookup
description: Read the user's own calendar for a given day.

name: delegate
description: Hand a complex, multi-step task to a stronger assistant that can plan, use many tools and come back with a summary. Use it when the request needs several steps or research beyond a single lookup.

task.description: The task to hand over, in one sentence.
